Downloads of audio, video and stems are currently disabled following Udio's UMG-related service changes.
records.customer_problem: A creator wants to generate and iteratively edit music without a traditional composition/production workflow.
records.solution_summary: Explain Udio around song generation/editing and current credit limits, while clearly disclosing that downloads are presently disabled.
limitations: subscription credits do not roll over
existing_content_risks: Catalog contains a shared Udio SKU that is not provider-authorized by this research.
Any page promising downloadable deliverables is stale under current provider state.
records.recommended_public_action: Rewrite Udio content before publication; do not market shared access or downloads as currently available.

verified_facts: Otter Pro is positioned for individuals and small teams and is billed per user.
Current official pricing shows 1200 in-app recording minutes, up to 90 minutes per meeting, advanced AI workflows and integrations on Pro.
Otter Business is a separate per-user team plan; team billing is not evidence for a transferable shared-login SKU.
records.customer_problem: A professional needs searchable meeting transcription, summaries, action items and meeting memory without manually taking notes.
records.solution_summary: Position Otter around meeting capture and searchable knowledge, with per-user/workspace billing explained clearly.
limitations: language/support coverage should be checked for the exact use case
existing_content_risks: Catalog lists Otter Pro as shared; current provider pricing is per-user and this research does not authorize shared credentials.
records.recommended_public_action: Quarantine shared-login framing and write a meeting-workflow decision guide.

verified_facts: Canva Pro is currently priced as an individual plan for one person on the US pricing surface.
Current Pro includes premium design assets, brand tools, social scheduling, 100GB storage and a substantially larger AI allowance than Free.
Canva Business is a distinct per-person team/business plan.
records.customer_problem: A creator or small business needs professional design, brand consistency, social publishing and AI-assisted creative work without a full design stack.
records.solution_summary: Explain Canva Pro through repeatable design/brand workflows, not a generic 'premium templates' pitch.
limitations: AI allowance is finite and varies by AI tier/tool
provider plan terms should be checked before team use
existing_content_risks: Catalog contains 'Starter Shared' Canva Pro. Current official individual pricing does not by itself authorize shared credentials.
records.recommended_public_action: Use personal/customer-owned access unless an exact authorized team-seat procurement model is documented.

provider_price.regional_note: price may adjust by location and billing plan

verified_facts: QuillBot Premium currently includes unlimited paraphrasing, advanced grammar guidance, Humanizer, custom summaries, AI Detector access and plagiarism-related features.
QuillBot states current price depends on region and selected subscription period, and checkout may localize currency/pricing.
Premium can be used across a user's devices, with anti-abuse limits; this is not evidence for multi-customer shared credentials.
records.customer_problem: A student or professional needs to rewrite, clarify, summarize and proofread text faster while keeping control over tone and originality checks.
records.solution_summary: Position QuillBot as a writing-revision toolkit, especially for rewriting, grammar, summaries and citation/academic workflow support.
limitations: AI rewriting still requires human review
academic use must respect institutional rules
existing_content_risks: Catalog hard-codes $9.95 and shared tiers; current official material shows a different annual-equivalent figure and regional variability.
records.recommended_public_action: Replace stale provider-price assumptions and quarantine shared-login variants.
